scope: All 723 unique original QC-passing poses; compare previous distinct-kinase top10. Not a fresh search of rejected pools or discarded poses.
primary_diagnostic: 4A correct-head contacts plus maximum intercomponent heavy-atom overlap <=0.6A; ligand covalent geometry 1.0-2.1A and no internal nonbonded overlaps >0.8A excluding 1-2/1-3 pairs. Operational thresholds, not MolProbity or binding validation.
reference_policy: Head chemical mappings must be unique atom sets; invalid reference-head bond lengths prevent validated pocket-engagement/RMSD claims. Correct-head contacts alone do not establish pocket engagement.
